changelog:
Initial release of GInstall OneClick skill.

- Enables one-click installation of GitHub Node.js projects via the ginstall CLI.
- Normalizes repo URLs (supports owner/repo, full URLs, branch/subpath for monorepos).
- Handles both public and private repos, supporting GITHUB_TOKEN for authentication.
- Guides users through cloning, installing dependencies, and starting dev scripts.
- Provides full reference for relevant flags, modes, and environment variables.
summary: GInstall OneClick — one-click installation of GitHub projects: plan, clone, install Node deps, run dev scripts. Use when the user wants a GitHub Node.js repo...
